```{r}
fn <- function(x = c("foo", "bar")) rlang::arg_match(x)
fn("bar")

# Throws an informative error for mismatches:
try(fn("b"))
try(fn("baz"))

# Use the bare-bones version with explicit values for speed:
arg_match0("bar", c("foo", "bar", "baz"))

# For convenience:
fn1 <- function(x = c("bar", "baz", "foo")) fn3(x)
fn2 <- function(x = c("baz", "bar", "foo")) fn3(x)
fn3 <- function(x) rlang::arg_match0(x, c("foo", "bar", "baz"))
fn1()
fn2("bar")
try(fn3("zoo"))


```

```{r}
add_d_to_quo_env <- function(q, .d) {
    q |> 
        purrr:::modify(
            \(x) {
                rlang::quo_set_env(
                    quo = x,
                    env = rlang::new_environment(
                        data = list(.d = .d),
                        parent = rlang::quo_get_env(x)
                    )
                )
            }
        )

    # for (i in seq_along(q)) {
    #     parent_env <- rlang::quo_get_env(q[[i]])
    #     child_env <- rlang::env(parent_env, .d = .d)
    #     q[[i]] <- rlang::quo_set_env(q[[i]], child_env)
    # }
    
    # q
}

my_func <- function(.data, ...) {
    dots <- rlang::enquos(..., .named = TRUE) |> 
        add_d_to_quo_env(.d = .data)

    .data |> 
        dplyr::summarise(!!! dots)
}

mtcars |> 
    dplyr::group_by(cyl) |> 
    my_func(
        mean(cyl) + nrow(.d), 
        mean(mpg / 2) + dplyr::n_groups(.d)
    ) 
```
